description: WRITE (DESTRUCTIVE when dry_run=false): publish a draft. dry_run=true (default) only VALIDATES the draft without changing anything. dry_run=false APPLIES the draft to the LIVE catalog — this can create, modify, or DELETE running data pipelines and their data. Set dry_run=false only when you intend to change live infrastructure. Estuary control-plane: POST /publications. Returns the publication row.

detail.description: Optional human-readable note for this publication.

dry_run.description: If true (DEFAULT), only validate without applying. Set false to APPLY to the live catalog.

name: estuary_publish_draft
title: Publish draft
